questions.question: Against what is the oracle in Ezekiel 35?
Why is Mount Seir (Edom) judged?
options: For seizing for itself all of the temple's gold and its silver
For stubbornly refusing to pay any tribute at all to Babylon
For perpetual enmity and gloating over Israel's downfall
For bowing down to worship all of the many idols of the nations
questions.answer: For perpetual enmity and gloating over Israel's downfall

questions.question: God said he would make Mount Seir a desolation because of its hatred toward Israel.
